scenarios.name: Michaung 2023
scenarios.description: Historical rainfall scenario for the December 2023 Cyclone Michaung event over Ward 176, Velachery.
limitations: Rainfall is a single coarse IMERG grid-cell (0.1 degree) area-averaged series, not dense street-level gauge observations.
The same rainfall series is applied uniformly to all 35 model subcatchments.

whatIf.label: Rainfall multiplier (what-if sensitivity)
whatIf.description: What-if rainfall sensitivity scenario: every rainfall intensity of the historical series is multiplied by the same factor; timestamps, interval and duration are unchanged. Not a forecast, warning or climate projection.
